versions.changelog: AI phone receptionist: scrapes your website, builds knowledge base, spins up VAPI voice assistant, connects Twilio phone number, logs calls to HubSpot CRM with SMS follow-ups. Free OpenClaw skill.
Added install.sh bootstrap: auto-installs scrapling, Playwright, and flowconcierge shell alias in one command.

FlowConcierge v1.0.0

- Initial release: Instantly deploy an AI phone receptionist for any business using your website content.
- Scrapes your website, builds a knowledge base, and spins up a VAPI AI voice assistant.
- Auto-purchases a Twilio phone number, connects it, and handles calls.
- Logs every call into HubSpot CRM, with optional SMS follow-ups to callers.
- Fast setup with CLI commands and environment variable support.
